Found 54 papers for CFTR, of 1962 available.⁠1–20

The Hdj-2/Hsc70 chaperone pair facilitates early steps in CFTR biogenesis, and the Hsc70 co-chaperone CHIP targets immature CFTR for proteasomal degradation.⁠1, 22 Sodium 4-phenylbutyrate downregulates Hsc70 with implications for intracellular trafficking of DeltaF508-CFTR.⁠7

CHANNEL REGULATION AND PROTEIN INTERACTIONS

The two nucleotide binding domains have differential functions on CFTR, and protein kinase A associates with CFTR through ezrin.⁠5, 9 E3KARP mediates the association of ezrin and protein kinase A with CFTR in airway cells.⁠12 AMP-activated protein kinase inhibits CFTR through a novel interaction, and PDZ-domain-mediated bivalent interaction regulates CFTR single-channel gating.⁠11, 23 The PDZ-interacting domain of CFTR is required for functional expression at the apical membrane, and the NHERF PDZ1 domain structurally contacts the CFTR carboxyl-terminus.⁠10, 28 An accessory protein facilitates CFTR–CFTR interaction to potentiate chloride channel activity.⁠15

MUTATIONS AND GENOTYPE–PHENOTYPE STUDIES

A homozygous D579G cystic fibrosis patient showed pancreatic sufficiency and minor lung involvement, and a novel D513G missense mutation was identified in a French CBAVD patient.⁠2, 6 Genetic findings in congenital bilateral aplasia of the vas deferens patients included six novel mutations.⁠3 The S1235R mutation's frequency and clinical significance were assessed collaboratively, and CFTR mutations including three novel substitutions were characterized in asthma, bronchiectasis, and COPD patients.⁠26, 30 A regulatory DNase I hypersensitive site 20.9 kb upstream of CFTR was also analyzed.⁠4

CLINICAL AND POPULATION ASSOCIATIONS

Neonatal screening studies addressed early diagnosis of cystic fibrosis and prevalence of CFTR mutations in hypertrypsinaemia.⁠21, 24 Worldwide genetic analysis of the CFTR region was also reported, as was the influence of the mannose binding lectin gene on chronic liver disease severity in cystic fibrosis.⁠17, 29
